title: Elaine Malloy First Meeting

nodes.speaker: Elaine Malloy
nodes.text: Wow you have a really unique look! It's a sort of, hmmm, homeless-chic with an air of misplaced hope. Ever been in a train gang?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Wow you have a really unique look! It's a sort of, hmmm, homeless-chic with an air of misplaced hope. Ever been in a train gang?

nodes.speaker: Elaine Malloy
nodes.text: I once photographed a hobo leader called Hipflask or Hackdash or something. Deep, sunken eyes that told stories. Made a lot of Lims off that portrait!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I once photographed a hobo leader called Hipflask or Hackdash or something. Deep, sunken eyes that told stories. Made a lot of Lims off that portrait!

nodes.speaker: Elaine Malloy
nodes.text: Sorry are your optics working? You can see me right? You know who I am.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sorry are your optics working? You can see me right? You know who I am.

nodes.speaker: Elaine Malloy
nodes.text: Elaine Malloy? Ringing any bells?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Elaine Malloy? Ringing any bells?

nodes.speaker: Elaine Malloy
nodes.text: This part of town truly is fascinating, almost completely culturally cut off from society. Well, just to make you, aware, most people would beg me to take their portrait, even pay vast amounts to have me photograph them.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This part of town truly is fascinating, almost completely culturally cut off from society. Well, just to make you, aware, most people would beg me to take their portrait, even pay vast amounts to have me photograph them.

nodes.speaker: Elaine Malloy
nodes.text: Well let me give you a second for it to sink in, for some, the prospect of me taking their photo can be a shock to the system.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well let me give you a second for it to sink in, for some, the prospect of me taking their photo can be a shock to the system.

nodes.speaker: Elaine Malloy
nodes.text: Well in this instance, that would be very foolish of you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well in this instance, that would be very foolish of you.

nodes.speaker: Elaine Malloy
nodes.text: Well if you start to feel dizzy, don't faint towards me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well if you start to feel dizzy, don't faint towards me.

nodes.speaker: Elaine Malloy
nodes.text: How about my one to one training under the tutorship of G.G. O'Brien, the greatest photographer to ever have lived. Before me of course.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How about my one to one training under the tutorship of G.G. O'Brien, the greatest photographer to ever have lived. Before me of course.

nodes.speaker: Elaine Malloy
nodes.text: Oh you really are too much! Your arrogance is actually fascinating to me. No really, I'm actually more interested in you now if anything.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh you really are too much! Your arrogance is actually fascinating to me. No really, I'm actually more interested in you now if anything.

nodes.speaker: Elaine Malloy
nodes.text: Tell you what. I have a spare ASScap you can borrow.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Tell you what. I have a spare ASScap you can borrow.

nodes.speaker: Elaine Malloy
nodes.text: Tragic HOVA accident. Apparently somebody cut off the feed to the air brake and well... let's just say it's hard to take photographs without a working pelvis. A real tragedy.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Tragic HOVA accident. Apparently somebody cut off the feed to the air brake and well... let's just say it's hard to take photographs without a working pelvis. A real tragedy.

nodes.speaker: Elaine Malloy
nodes.text: Sadly not. Could have been anyone, the photography business is cutthroat. Toughest business out there.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sadly not. Could have been anyone, the photography business is cutthroat. Toughest business out there.

nodes.speaker: Elaine Malloy
nodes.text: Ambient Spacial Snapshot ... capture. A new way to take pictures. Take a snapshot of an entire environment and choose your angle later. Ultimate control.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ambient Spacial Snapshot ... capture. A new way to take pictures. Take a snapshot of an entire environment and choose your angle later. Ultimate control.

nodes.speaker: Elaine Malloy
nodes.text: Oh this old chestnut. When will people learn that photography is about the moment. Not about the angle.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh this old chestnut. When will people learn that photography is about the moment. Not about the angle.

nodes.speaker: Elaine Malloy
nodes.text: People take great photos, well some people. No the ASSCap is just a tool like any other.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: People take great photos, well some people. No the ASSCap is just a tool like any other.

nodes.speaker: Elaine Malloy
nodes.text: Rain and Strauss just commissioned me to put together my next book. Staying Local - A Visual History of the Unity Zone.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Rain and Strauss just commissioned me to put together my next book. Staying Local - A Visual History of the Unity Zone.

nodes.speaker: Elaine Malloy
nodes.text: History is history and we're gonna make it. Together. You take that camera, get me some snaps in each of the districts, and maybe just maybe, you'll get featured.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: History is history and we're gonna make it. Together. You take that camera, get me some snaps in each of the districts, and maybe just maybe, you'll get featured.

nodes.speaker: Elaine Malloy
nodes.text: Credit? I'm not sure what that means exactly. I can look into the idea of some kind of payment. What currency do you people like down here? Lims is it? We could make something work.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Credit? I'm not sure what that means exactly. I can look into the idea of some kind of payment. What currency do you people like down here? Lims is it? We could make something work.

nodes.speaker: Elaine Malloy
nodes.text: Great. This could be great for me... and us. I can look into the idea of some kind of payment. What currency do you people like down here? Lims is it? We could make something work.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Great. This could be great for me... and us. I can look into the idea of some kind of payment. What currency do you people like down here? Lims is it? We could make something work.

nodes.speaker: Elaine Malloy
nodes.text: Possible. But not important. But his look was... unique.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Possible. But not important. But his look was... unique.

nodes.speaker: Elaine Malloy
nodes.text: What a ridiculous question. How about more cover-photos for Vanguard magazine than any other living photographer?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What a ridiculous question. How about more cover-photos for Vanguard magazine than any other living photographer?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No I have not.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No I have not.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sorry what is going on here?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sorry what is going on here?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Sorry what is going on here?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Sorry what is going on here?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm afraid not.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm afraid not.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So you're a photographer?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So you're a photographer?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Nope.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nope.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Oh yes of course!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh yes of course!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I feel fine.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I feel fine.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I wouldn't pay to be photographed.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I wouldn't pay to be photographed.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I wouldn't pay to be photographed.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I wouldn't pay to be photographed.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Maybe I don't want you to take my photo.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe I don't want you to take my photo.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Maybe I don't want you to take my photo.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Maybe I don't want you to take my photo.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What makes your photographs so much better than everyone else's?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What makes your photographs so much better than everyone else's?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What makes your photographs so much better than everyone else's?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What makes your photographs so much better than everyone else's?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Is photography really that hard?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Is photography really that hard?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: ...Thanks?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: ...Thanks?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What happened to G.G.?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What happened to G.G.?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Did they ever find the culprit?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Did they ever find the culprit?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Did they ever find the culprit?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Did they ever find the culprit?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That cannot be true...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That cannot be true...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're right, this is a lot to take in.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're right, this is a lot to take in.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You're right, this is a lot to take in.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You're right, this is a lot to take in.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds like a good opportunity.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds like a good opportunity.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds like it!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds like it!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Excuse me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Excuse me?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds like cheating.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds like cheating.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I bet it takes great photos.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I bet it takes great photos.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I bet it takes great photos.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I bet it takes great photos.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why would you give one to me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why would you give one to me?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Why would you give one to me?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Why would you give one to me?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: History of the Unity Zone? It's only a few days old.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: History of the Unity Zone? It's only a few days old.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: History of the Unity Zone? It's only a few days old.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: History of the Unity Zone? It's only a few days old.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And you take all the credit?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And you take all the credit?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: And you take all the credit?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: And you take all the credit?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Huckstash?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Huckstash?
